decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Before the development permitted under planning permission reference 00843/3&3A/P2, dated 6/8/07, is first occupied the landscaping approved under this permission 00843/3&3A/P2 (19 and 22) shall have been carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the hereby approved detail applications (Planning Ref: 00843/3&3A/P2 (19 and 20) the materials to be used in the construction of the access road within the site are not approved and will be dealt with under the Condition 2 (Materials) of approved permission 00843/3&3A/P2.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing buildings and the erection of a 3 storey block of 9 x 2 bedroom flats and 3 x 1 bedroom flats and 2 x 3-storey 4 bedroom terrace houses and 3 x 3 storey 3 bedroom terrace houses with 24 associated new car parking spaces to the site- details submitted pursuant to Condition 19 (Landscape Maintenance) of approved  by legal dated 06/08/2007
